name.ja: 30MM 1/144 bEXM-14T シエルノヴァ[ダークグレー]

description.ja: 30MMシリーズバイロン軍より新機体「シエルノヴァ」が登場！ポルタノヴァとの連動でカスタマイズの幅がより広がる！
description.en: A new aircraft "Ciel Nova" is now available from the 30MM series Byron Army! The range of customization is expanded by linking with Portanova!

description.ja: • マッシヴな脚部、長い前腕、上方向に拡張できるバックパックなど、特徴的なパーツ構成。
description.en: • Distinctive parts configuration including massive legs, long forearms, and a backpack that can expand upwards.

description.ja: • 拡張可能な関節機構を採用。新規の股関節パーツを既存の機体に組み込み、体型のアレンジが可能。
description.en: • Adopts expandable joint mechanism. The new hip joint parts can be incorporated into the existing fuselage to rearrange the body shape.

description.ja: • 指揮官機用、特殊部隊用、近接格闘用の胸部パーツはポルタノヴァと連動。
description.en: • Chest parts for commander aircraft, special forces, and close combat are linked with Portanova.
